title: Reminder rows are in days; a before row must be shorter than the interval
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in, on the build under test, as an Owner/Admin or as a user with "Settings Service" enabled.
  2. In the left sidebar under Settings, open the "Maintenance" entry beneath "Inspection Templates" (if the build shows "Maintenance schedules" instead, use that entry and record the label). Schedules are shared by the whole organization, whichever location is chosen in the header.
  3. The Add service form open on a routine service (New schedule > Add service), name "PM-A", calendar Every 1 month.
custom_steps:
1. Read the default reminder rows and the controls on one row.
  2. Try to delete the "On the due date" row; then add rows until Add reminder disables.
  3. Set a before row to 366 days; then make two rows identical (e.g. two "before 10 days").
  4. Set the before row to 30 days, then 29 days.
  5. Change the calendar to Every 7 days and set the before row to 7 days, then 6 days.
  6. Hover the (i) beside the reminder rows, and hover the disabled delete on the "On the due date" row.
  7. Open a schedule in the service builder and hover the (i) on the reminder step.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Three default rows: 14 days before, on the due date, 7 days after; each row reads [before | after] [n] [days], in days only.
  • The due-date row's delete control is disabled (visible, not hidden); after five rows Add reminder disables.
  • 366 is refused (days run 1 to 365); the two identical rows cannot both be saved.
  • With Every 1 month (counted as 30 days) 30 is refused inline and 29 is accepted.
  • With Every 7 days 7 is refused inline and 6 is accepted.
  • On the design the (i) reads "Days from this service’s due date, up to five, when it starts to read due soon. The reminder on the due date cannot be removed." and the disabled delete's tooltip reads "The reminder on the due date cannot be removed."
  • On the design that (i) reads "Every new service starts with these rows. Days from this service’s own due date, up to five, when it starts to read due soon."

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780, story SV-10562 (S5, Reminder timing), Chunk 1 MR (Confluence 886931488) as edited 5 October 2026, S5 (The rows; S5-R1 to S5-R4, S5-R12); Plan 1 — Track, act, clear — Technical Implementation Plan, section 6 Phase P1, frontend tests (serviceFormRules); Design board "Chunk 1.dc.html" (MR V2 Claude Design project, version of 6 October 2026), service form P04 to P06 and artboards R4, R4ro; read 6 Oct 2026. Source-verified 6 October 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S5-R1: “each reading [ before | after ] [ n ] [ days ]. Rows are in days and nothing else”
  • S5-R3: “The due date row cannot be deleted. Its delete control is disabled, not hidden”
  • S5-R12: “A reminder row's days run 1 to 365. Two identical rows cannot both be saved”
  • S5-R12: “For an interval in months, a month counts as 30 days, so a 1-month service allows a before row of 1 to 29 days”
  • S5-R12: “A before row must be shorter than the service's calendar interval: for a service every 7 days, a before row runs 1 to 6 days. A before row of the interval or longer is refused inline”
  • S5-R2: “Every new service starts with three default rows: 14 days before, on the due date, and 7 days after”
  • S5-R4: “The ceiling is five rows, after which Add reminder disables”
  • Design board, service form (reminder (i)): “Days from this service’s due date, up to five, when it starts to read due soon. The reminder on the due date cannot be removed.”
  • Design board, service form (due-date row tooltip): “The reminder on the due date cannot be removed.”
  • Design board, artboards R4 and R4ro (reminder step (i)): “Every new service starts with these rows. Days from this service’s own due date, up to five, when it starts to read due soon.”
